review: Independent Scripture and fidelity pass over Witte Book I §§1–114 and Book II §§1–35 against the locked first-pass Greek in translations/pascha_source.json. Quotation wording follows the papyrus/Witte, not a modern critical NT when they differ. Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German were not used for wording. 1.94 is Victor of Capua's Latin (Greek lost).
